name: wick
title: Wick
description: Start and control Wick, the screen-border timer.
author: tw

commands.name: start
commands.title: Start Timer
commands.subtitle: Wick
commands.description: Start a Wick timer. Accepts 25, 45m, 1h30 or 90s.

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Pause or Resume Timer
commands.subtitle: Wick
commands.description: Pause a running Wick timer, or resume a paused one.

commands.name: add
commands.title: Add Time
commands.subtitle: Wick
commands.description: Stretch the running timer. Defaults to 5 minutes.

commands.name: stop
commands.title: Stop Timer
commands.subtitle: Wick
commands.description: Clear the timer and the border.
